comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Farrer Park MRT about 350 m, Little India MRT about 740 m; closer than 478 of 662 similar developments (the same as 5). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest Farrer Park Primary School about 200 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 170 m), more than 362 of 662 similar developments (the same as 63); nearest hawker centre Pek Kio Market And Food Centre about 230 m; nearest park Mount Emily Park about 1,040 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Pek Kio Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 430 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 990 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,080 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,290 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,300 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,410 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,830 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,890 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 370 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 85 new sales and 1,026 resales (1,111 purchases); new sales were 7.7% of these purchases. Subsales (61) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,026 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 614 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,026 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,094 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.2%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
